_classes.name: grant_only gate flips a duty to power when the quote has no grant word (list item or mandated statement text)
_classes.rule: kind_adjusted=='grant_only' AND kind_model=='duty' AND kind=='power' AND quote, after removing uppercase statement runs of 15+ chars, has no may|authorized|empowered|power|discretion

_classes.name: Grant cap on the granting agency dropped as benefit_entitlement

_classes.name: Event-triggered deadline stored on_effective_date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' AND quote matches within N hours|days|months thereafter/after the|such|receipt|each, upon receipt|request|the filing, or thereafter

_classes.name: Named body left Unspecified

2011-S7000-01.quote: Upon receipt of a petition signed by not less than twenty-five voters qualified to vote at a general election in the town, the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall conduct an election at which the issues shall be:

2011-S7000-02.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall give notice of such election by publication of notice at least twice in one or more newspapers having a general circulation in the district to be served.

2011-S7000-03.quote: In addition, the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall cause copies of such notice to be posted conspicuously in three public places in the district at least thirteen days prior to the date of such election.

2011-S7000-04.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall designate a resident qualified voter of such district to act as chairperson of any election of such district and shall designate not less than two nor more than four resident qualified voters to act as election inspectors and ballot clerks at such election.

2011-S7000-05.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library may adopt a resolution providing that such chairperson, election inspectors and ballot clerks shall be paid reasonable compensation for their respective services at such election.

2011-S7000-06.quote: The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library may, to the extent authorized by law, authorize the use of absentee ballots for the election.

2011-S7000-07.quote: After the polls have closed at such election, the election inspectors and the ballot clerks shall immediately canvass publicly the ballots cast and the chairperson of the election shall publicly announce the result.
2011-S7000-07.note: Inspectors are designated by the library board ("The board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library shall designate ... election inspectors and ballot clerks"); not a county board of elections.

2011-S7000-08.quote: Within seventy-two hours thereafter, the chairperson, election inspectors and ballot clerks shall execute and file a certificate of the result of the canvass with the board of trustees of the existing Grinnell library and the town and village clerks.
2011-S7000-08.note: "Within seventy-two hours thereafter" runs from the close of the polls at an undated election: event-triggered, not on_effective_date.

2011-S7000-09.quote: In the event that the district is created, there shall be an annual election conducted by the board of trustees of the Grinnell public library district in accordance with the provisions of subdivision one of this section at a time to be set by the board of trustees of the district

2011-S7000-10.quote: At the first regular meeting of the board of trustees of the district, the trustees shall determine when the terms of office of each member shall expire as follows:

2011-S7000-11.quote: All other vacancies caused by resignation, removal, death, or inability to serve shall be filled by appointment by the board of trustees of the district until the next election, at which time the vacancy shall be filled by election for the remaining portion of the term.

2011-S7000-12.quote: The board of trustees at its first meeting after each annual election shall elect or appoint a president and vice-president, who shall be members of the board, and a secretary, treasurer, and such other officers as they deem necessary.

2013-S2372-08.quote: The task force shall be chaired by the commissioner, or by such officer or employee of the department as shall be designated by the commissioner.

2013-S2372-09.quote: The commissioner, may request the assistance of state agencies to carry out the work of the task force.

missed.quote: Any state agency or Municipality with title in fee or of a lesser interest to vacant public land may permit community organizations to use such lands for community gardening purposes.
missed.note: {{in fee or of a lesser interest}} widens the existing State-agency power too; only the Municipalities record (-05) was stored (joint actors stored for one body).
